n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
f = [0] * maxn
c = [0] * maxn
dp1 = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
dp2 = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
fat = [0] * maxn
inv = [0] * maxn
inv_fat = [0] * maxn

def calc():
    fat[0] = fat[1] = inv[1] = inv_fat[0] = inv_fat[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, maxn):
        fat[i] = (fat[i - 1] * i) % mod
        inv[i] = mod - ( (mod // i) * inv[mod % i] % mod )
        inv_fat[i] = (inv_fat[i - 1] * inv[i]) % mod

def choose(a, b):
    return (fat[a] * (inv_fat[b] * inv_fat[a - b] % mod)) % mod

def p(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

calc()

f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        f[i] += (choose(i - 1, j) * f[j] % mod) * f[i - 1 - j] % mod
        f[i] %= mod
        c[i] += ( (i + 1) * choose(i - 1, j) % mod ) * ( (f[j] * c[i - 1 - j] % mod) + (f[i - 1 - j] * c[j] % mod) ) % mod
        c[i] %= mod
        c[i] += (choose(i - 1, j) * (p(j) + p(i - 1 - j)) % mod) * (f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % mod) % mod
        c[i] %= mod
    f[i] = (f[i] * (i + 1)) % mod

dp1[0][0] = 1
for k in range(1, n + 1):
    dp1[k][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, min(m, k) + 1):
        dp1[k][i] = dp1[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val = (f[j] * dp1[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val = (val * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp1[k][i] = (dp1[k][i] + val) % mod

        dp2[k][i] = dp2[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val_c = (c[j] * dp1[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val_c = (val_c * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp2[k][i] = (dp2[k][i] + val_c) % mod

            val_f = (f[j] * dp2[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            val_f = (val_f * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dp2[k][i] = (dp2[k][i] + val_f) % mod

print(dp2[n][m])
